explanation: The theorem gives the a.e. weak gradient of the reflection extension of a W^{1,p} function from the normal epigraph of a Lipschitz graph. It depends on the library's own definitions: W1p.gradient, normalEpigraphExtensionL, graphFlattening and normalReflection. I searched Mathlib for W1p, normalEpigraph and Sobolev-space material. The only hits were SobolevInequality, BesselPotentialSpace and Distribution/Sobolev. The last of these has no matches for W1p, normalEpigraph, weakGradient or reflection. I found nothing in Mathlib, Batteries or core that states this result or a general form of it.
